review.why: Tracks job applications, follow-ups, interviews and offers in local JSON files.
review.summary: Job search tracker that logs applications, interviews, rejections and offers, schedules follow-up reminders, compares offers and produces stats and weekly reports from local JSON files.
cautions: Reminders are only textual, no real scheduling

notes: Writes profile and history files under a local ~/.openclaw folder; stores personal data beyond the resume.
